VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER1_EPOCH.title: First Thunder of Vorrijaard
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER1_EPOCH.description:
Long before warm-bloods walked upright across the permafrost, Volibear and his fellow demigods shaped the primordial land known as Vorrijaard.
He was destruction, brute strength, and the storm made flesh. Legend tells that a single sweep of his paw carved the Five Fjords into the earth; he battled the magma serpent Rhond for days, the behemoth's scalding blood pouring forth to form the first great river while its colossal bones rose to become the Wyrmback Mountains.
In that era when untamed magic surged freely, the first tribes called upon the ancient name of Valhir in reverence—for only through the Thunder Demigod's unbridled fury could fragile mortals survive the brutal winter.
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER1_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Completed a run as The Ironclad.|Complete a run as The Ironclad to reveal this historical node.}
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER1_EPOCH.unlock: The storm gathers at the base of the Spire! Volibear bares his claws and thunder...
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER1_EPOCH.unlockText: Unlocks Volibear as a playable character.
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER2_EPOCH.title: Shattered Runic Armor
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER2_EPOCH.description:
When the Three Sisters rose to power, seeking to rule the north through order, Volibear ascended to Hearth-Home, domain of his brother Ornn, and demanded he forge weapons for his Ursine host.
"No," the Forge Demigod refused without looking up. "The people in the town below are not my followers. They make things for themselves."
For centuries, the Hearthblood neither knelt nor offered sacrifices, yet held a selfless reverence for Ornn—an unfamiliar warmth that pierced the Thunder Bear's envy and pride.
The two brothers fought atop the summit for eight days and eight nights. Lightning and magma tore the sky asunder; cursing, Volibear ripped apart the runic armor Ornn had forged and brought the entire mountain crashing down with fang and thunder alone, burying thousands of the Hearthblood in ash.
Freed from iron plate, he grew more savage than ever before. Yet whenever his storms swept past that bald, smokeless volcano, he let out a scornful snort—hating that stubborn ram for refusing to stand at his side, and hating even more that a creator who had once wrestled the earth itself would sheath all his edge for a crowd of dead mortals.
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER2_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Cleared Act 1 as Volibear.|Clear Act 1 as Volibear to reveal this historical node.}
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER3_EPOCH.title: Today, You Are Free
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER3_EPOCH.description:
[sine]"Valhir! In your name we kill, and in your name we die!"[/sine]
The call of a blood offering woke the Great Bear from his long slumber. Descending upon the battlefield like rolling thunder, he tore the invading foreign army to shreds in moments.
Blood-streaked Warmother Raetha fell to both knees, thanking the demigod for saving their village.
"Stand," Volibear growled, looking down at her. "Warriors never kneel."
Then his gaze fell upon the man-made dam blocking the great river at the end of the gorge. Waters that should have roared like thunder barely reached his ankles.
With an earth-shaking roar, the Bear God waded into the shallows and tore the stone wall apart with his bare claws! The surging torrent instantly washed away the farmsteads and stone houses downstream. Looking upon the dumbstruck mortal tribe, the Stormlord raised his head in satisfaction:
[jitter]"Today, you are free! Born wild! Hunt! Kill! Follow the old ways... and the old ways will favor you!"[/jitter]
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER3_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Cleared Act 2 as Volibear.|Clear Act 2 as Volibear to reveal this historical node.}
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER4_EPOCH.title: A Roar From the Heart
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER4_EPOCH.description:
Warm-bloods learned to walk on two legs, yet gradually forgot how to run.
Still, Volibear knew better than anyone that even inside the frailest mortal chest, a beating heart still harbored untamed savagery.
When the Notai cub named Nunu stepped into Ramshara alongside his snow-bound behemoth, the Great Bear did not swallow the trembling child whole—instead, he unleashed a mountain-splitting roar of thunder before him:
[b]"You can roar in your own way, little cub. A true roar—your true strength—comes from within."[/b]
A child's hope is fierce, and despair is cruel—yet at least that heart still beat. When an otherworldly rift opened and the Spire appeared, snuffing out all life with dead stone and cold clockwork, Valhir followed the storm's call through its gates—never would he allow any creator to turn living hearts into gears.
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER4_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Cleared Act 3 as Volibear.|Clear Act 3 as Volibear to reveal this historical node.}

Volibear unleashes the full might of an old god; the rolling storm grows fiercer still...

VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER5_EPOCH.title: Bones Beneath the Ice
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER5_EPOCH.description:
A thousand years ago, a young witch named Lissandra sought to steal the demigods' might. Volibear struck her down before her entire army, permanently taking her sight with his claws—yet blinded, she pledged loyalty to the Watchers beneath the abyss, sealing away an entire era along with the Void rift in True Ice.
Centuries passed. Tribes turned their backs on the old gods, hiding behind high walls to worship false idols.
Throughout his long hibernation, Volibear dreamed again and again of a colossal skeleton frozen inside dark, unyielding ice.
[sine]"I sometimes wonder... could those bones be my own?"[/sine]
The Blight and twisted abominations infesting the Spire reek of the very same nauseating stench as the Watchers of old. Roaring, the Great Bear calls down sky-rending lightning, reducing the Elite horrors before him to char—an old god will never die in cold oblivion!
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER5_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Defeated 15 Elites as Volibear.|Defeat 15 Elites as Volibear to reveal this historical node.}
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER6_EPOCH.title: I Am the Storm
VOLIBEAR_CHARACTER6_EPOCH.description:
[jitter][aqua]"Beneath stone walls, there is no wild!!"[/aqua][/jitter]
A thunder-wreathed paw crashed downward, grinding the false idols and cold throne at the Spire's apex into dust!
Stone pillars snapped; the dome collapsed. Winds and tempests held back for countless ages poured inward through the fractured tower, and parched soil tasted blood and rain once more.
Standing amidst flying rubble and white lightning, the cream-white Great Bear threw back his head and howled beneath churning stormclouds.
Whether Preon's Spire or the permafrost of the Freljord, all works of mortals and forge-gods will rot in the end; only the wild endures.
So long as thunder still roars, and hunters still run—
[b]They may forget the old ways, yet the old ways will never forget them.[/b]
